title: Super. Human. station display
slide_intent: Test headline scale at viewing distance, because a public-space advertisement must communicate before a passerby stops to read.
strategic_value: The large extended headline, athlete portrait and small green 4 can connect a distinctive campaign with Channel 4 at a glance.
demonstration: A wide illuminated display above an escalator pairs a swimmer wearing goggles with the oversized white Super. Human. headline; a green 4, viewing prompt and Paralympics label sit at the left.
practical_value: Compare the campaign headline’s scale with the smaller broadcaster and programme information in a wide placement.

content_islands.name: Left information stack
content_islands.spec: Place the green 4 and small viewing/programme details at the left edge.

content_islands.name: Campaign image and headline
content_islands.spec: Center the swimmer and stretch the large white headline across the lower part of the display.

content_islands.name: Station context
content_islands.spec: Retain the ceiling and escalator foreground to show the screen’s scale and viewing position.

reference_purposes.Expression: A wide illuminated display above an escalator pairs a swimmer wearing goggles with the oversized white Super. Human. headline; a green 4, viewing prompt and Paralympics label sit at the left.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a wide station display.
